answer: Farms mint lookalike voters if a reused passphrase can join. This intake issues one serialized ivory plaque per applicant, lodged face-down in a hollow lockbox whose public box-id becomes the account's only anchor. Minting costs 1.15 POA; 23 POA stays locked for eight epochs. Verifiers recompute commit = whirlpool(serial||box_id||owner_pk), confirm the serial is unused on the mint log, and see exactly one plaque in the box. A shared serial, or a box found empty or double-stacked, forfeits both plaques and strips those keys of vote weight for twelve epochs.
